feedback: Repair the graph to target only mainFrame and intermediateIceFrame instances (or an explicitly equivalent supplied frame applicability), not every frame. Remove the needless nested hasStrengthenedPart path: the current sh:node is already the strengthened-part value, yet both alternatives repeat hasStrengthenedPart and therefore check the wrong entity/path. Place hasLowerEnd and its alternative constraints on the correct frame/strengthened-part path, respecting the declared owners and domains. Do not place ordinaryFrameScantlingsUsed, sameScantlingsAsMainFrame, or mainFrameBelowIceBeltStrengthened on the strengthened-part node; their supplied required owner is frame. Also do not make all three booleans conjunctively mandatory for the horizontal-member alternative: the note about main frames below the ice belt applies only to applicable main frames, while same scantlings must describe the permitted horizontal-member alternative. Preserve the attachment alternative and the termination-at-or-below-ice-belt plus adjacent-main-frame relationship, but encode the conditional applicability without an accidental universal pass or overbroad target.

Repair the conditional structure: keep one common hasStrengthenedPart path with its hasLowerEnd and attachment alternative, rather than duplicating hasStrengthenedPart in both branches. The horizontal-member alternative must be applicable only to intermediateIceFrame instances; as written, a mainFrame can pass that alternative. Add an explicit intermediateIceFrame applicability condition while preserving the required termination-below-supporting-structure, qualifying supporting-structure, horizontal-member, same-scantlings, adjacent-main-frame, and ice-strengthening checks on their authoritative frame/frame-end paths.
